title.zh: 能力声明不完整：插件实际行使网络访问和凭据文件读取，但 manifest 未声明相应能力

description.zh:
插件 manifest（package.json 的 dsh 字段）声明了 bundle.patch 和 client 配置，但未声明 network 或 fs 能力。

静态分析发现插件实际行使了以下未声明能力：网络访问——向 api.deepseek.com/user/balance 发送含用户 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 的余额查询请求（src/balance.ts 第 139 行），向 api-docs.deepseek.com 抓取定价页（src/pricing.ts 第 209 行）；文件系统读取——读取 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 凭据文件（src/balance.ts 第 127 行）和 ~/.dsh/sessions/ 下的会话日志（src/salvage.ts 第 97 行）。

这些行为本身与产品功能自洽（余额查询和报告生成），但生态的信任模型依赖能力声明来帮助用户理解插件权限，未声明即构成透明度缺口。
description.en:
The plugin manifest (the dsh field in package.json) declares bundle.patch and client configuration but does not declare network or fs capabilities.

Static analysis found that the plugin actually exercises the following undeclared capabilities: network access—sending a balance-query request containing the user's DEEPSEEK_API_KEY to api.deepseek.com/user/balance (src/balance.ts line 139), and fetching the pricing page from api-docs.deepseek.com (src/pricing.ts line 209); file-system reads—reading the credential file ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml (src/balance.ts line 127) and session logs under ~/.dsh/sessions/ (src/salvage.ts line 97).

These behaviors are self-consistent with the product features (balance query and report generation), but the ecosystem's trust model relies on capability declarations to help users understand plugin permissions; failure to declare them constitutes a transparency gap.

evidence.zh:
manifest 声明位置：package.json 第 56-68 行（dsh 字段仅含 bundle.patch 和 client.inject/platform）。
未声明能力证据：
- 网络请求：src/balance.ts:139（fetch 至 api.deepseek.com/user/balance）、src/pricing.ts:209（fetch 至 api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/）
- 凭据文件读取：src/balance.ts:127（readCredentialsKey 读取 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml）
- 会话日志读取：src/salvage.ts:97（readFileSync 读取 ~/.dsh/sessions/ 下日志文件）
evidence.en:
Manifest declaration location: package.json lines 56-68 (the dsh field contains only bundle.patch and client.inject/platform).
Evidence of undeclared capabilities:
- Network requests: src/balance.ts:139 (fetch to api.deepseek.com/user/balance), src/pricing.ts:209 (fetch to api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/)
- Credential-file read: src/balance.ts:127 (readCredentialsKey reads ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml)
- Session-log read: src/salvage.ts:97 (readFileSync reads log files under ~/.dsh/sessions/)

impact.zh:
用户安装插件时，manifest 未声明网络访问和文件读取能力，但插件实际运行时具备这些能力。依赖声明做安全审查的生态成员无法在安装前感知到该插件的真实权限范围。

触发条件：插件正常安装并在 dsh 宿主中加载后即可执行这些操作，无需额外用户交互。

定级依据：该能力缺口属于「过宽能力声明」（MEDIUM 典型情形），但插件的实际行为经分析确认与产品功能自洽、无恶意证据，因此定 MEDIUM 而非更高。
impact.en:
When a user installs the plugin, the manifest does not declare network-access and file-read capabilities, but the plugin actually has these capabilities at runtime. Ecosystem members relying on declarations for security review cannot perceive the plugin's true permission scope before installation.

Trigger condition: these operations can be executed after the plugin is installed normally and loaded in the dsh host, with no additional user interaction required.

Severity basis: this capability gap falls under "over-broad capability declaration" (typical MEDIUM case), but the plugin's actual behavior, after analysis, is confirmed to be self-consistent with the product features with no evidence of malice, so it is rated MEDIUM rather than higher.
